data.details:
Within the dynamic Doon School of Advanced Computing, a progressive education that fully embraces the New Education Policy (NEP) is delivered, ensuring that the students are not only participants but leaders in the evolving world of emerging technologies.

The undergraduate programs, B.Tech. in Computer Science & Engineering and the Bachelor of Computer Applications (BCA), are the product of a unique: 

  • Industry-immersive approach. 
  • Cutting-edge curriculum co-design, co-delivered and co-certified by HCLTech to empower students to become Industry ready from day one in the era of AI&ML.
  • "T-Skills” ensures a specialized understanding of core technological verticals, balanced with a broad competence across various application domains such as AI/ML, Robotics, IOT, Drone Technology, iOS Development, Finance’ Modern Media, Data Science, Cyber Security, Full Stack Development, Cloud Computing, Smart Agriculture.
  • Subjects aligned to professional and industry form the very first semester itself.
  • Full Stack development method used for hands-on within first two years.
  • Experiential Learning through
    • Internships every year
    • 4 Industry aligned projects
    • Access to Super Computer
    • Apple Labs
    • Drone Manufacturing, testing, troubleshooting and simulation lab
    • Quantum Computing, Robotics and Automation, Internet of Things Labs 
    • Hackathons as leaders
  • Programs benchmarked for next 10 Years for Industry relevance

For postgraduate programs the school offers, M. Tech in CSE, MCA, Integrated B.Tech CSE + M.Tech and Integrated B.Tech CSE + MBA  and Ph.D. programs challenge scholars to engage with the creation and implementation of advanced technologies, fostering innovation and original research.

data.areaDetails2:
The B.Tech. CSE and BCA programs at DBS Global University are crafted in collaboration with industry leaders, ensuring that they are co-designed, co-delivered, and co-certified. This unique approach bridges the gap between academia and industry, providing students with real-world skills and knowledge. The curriculum is structured to include:

An industry partner plays a crucial role in co-designed, co-delivered, and co-certified undergraduate (UG) programs by bridging the gap between academia and industry. Their involvement ensures that students gain industry-relevant skills, making them more employable. Here’s how they contribute at each stage:

Co-Designed Curriculum

Industry partners collaborate with academia to design the curriculum by:

  • Identifying emerging trends and skills needed in the industry.
  • Incorporating real-world case studies, projects, and tools used in the field.
  • Ensuring alignment with industry certifications and job roles.
  • Providing internship and placement opportunities as part of the course structure.

Co-Delivered Courses

Industry experts contribute to program delivery through:

  • Guest lectures, masterclasses, and hands-on workshops.
  • Conducting hackathons, live projects, and simulations.
  • Mentoring students on capstone projects and research assignments.
  • Hosting industrial visits and internships for practical exposure.

Co-Certified Credentials

Industry certification enhances the credibility of the program through:

  • Issuing joint certifications with the university.
  • Aligning the curriculum with recognized industry certifications (e.g., AWS, Microsoft, Cisco).
  • Evaluating projects and skills to ensure industry standards.
  • Offering fast-track recruitment or internship opportunities to certified graduates.

Benefits of Industry Collaboration

  • Enhanced employability: Graduates gain job-ready skills.
  • Industry-aligned learning: Students work on real-world problems.
  • Faculty development: Educators stay updated with industry trends.
  • Stronger industry-academia ties: Leads to more research and innovation opportunities.
Industry-Integrated Learning: Bridging Academia and Industry

We ensure our students are industry-ready with:

Live Projects & Hackathons: Solve real-world challenges.

Summer Abroad | Semester Abroad | One Year Abroad

Students can take on new academic challenges and enhance their learning experiences by taking advantage of the fascinating global opportunities that DBS Global University offers. Studying abroad provides students with the exceptional opportunity to immerse themselves in a foreign culture and form lifelong relationships with people from all over the world. While studying abroad, students gain new perspectives and face intellectual challenges that help them grow both academically and personally.

At DBS Global University, students will have the chance to join the Education Immersion Program. They can choose from a variety of study abroad options, including One Week, Two Week, One Month, Two Months, Six Months, and One Year programs at over 20+ partner universities and institutions worldwide.

For more details, please contact the Office of the Director of International Affairs at director.int@dgu.ac.in
